title: Belt and Road Initiative
displaytitle: Belt and Road Initiative

titles.display: Belt and Road Initiative

extract: The Belt and Road Initiative, also known as One Belt One Road and sometimes called the New Silk Road, is a global infrastructure and economic development strategy pursued by the government of China since 2013. It includes projects in more than 150 countries spanning ports, railways, highways, power stations, aviation, and telecommunications.
